action_items: Fix the logout regression in /app/frontend/app/impostazioni.tsx line 70. The route `/cerca` sits inside the `(tabs)` group so `router.replace('/cerca')` is unresolvable while the current screen is the sibling `/impostazioni` route. Options: (a) `router.replace('/(tabs)/cerca')` with the group in the path, (b) `router.dismissAll()` first then `router.replace('/(tabs)/cerca')`, or (c) call `router.replace('/')` (the index screen at /app/frontend/app/index.tsx) — simplest and matches the fresh-load flow, then let AuthGate show login. Verify with the exact reproduction: login -> open Impostazioni -> Esci -> login again -> expect search-input visible on /cerca (and NOT impostazioni-screen).
critical_code_review_comments: impostazioni.tsx:22-41 change-password flow correctly calls `signIn(next)` right after `changePassword` to swap the revoked token for a fresh one, then delays 900ms before `router.back()` so the success message is visible — this is the exact fix that solved the primary bug and it works end-to-end on the web preview.

impostazioni.tsx:70 logout `router.replace('/cerca')` triggers an unhandled REPLACE action because Expo Router can't resolve the tabs-nested `cerca` from a sibling `/impostazioni` route without the `(tabs)` group prefix. Use `router.replace('/(tabs)/cerca')` or `router.replace('/')`.
server.py auth is clean: password_version bump on change atomically revokes old JWTs via the `pv` claim check in require_auth (line 162-164), and the seed is idempotent (line 58-66).

rca_of_issue: Router error 'The action REPLACE with payload {name:(tabs), screen:cerca} was not handled by any navigator. Do you have a route named (tabs)?'. In Expo Router, `/cerca` under `app/(tabs)/cerca.tsx` needs to be reached with the group syntax when the current route (`app/impostazioni.tsx`) is a sibling of the `(tabs)` group. `router.replace('/cerca')` gets resolved into a REPLACE targeting the `(tabs)` navigator, but that navigator isn't mounted from the /impostazioni context, so the action is dropped. Result: URL and internal router state stay at /impostazioni, then signOut runs → AuthGate mounts login-screen, and on re-login AuthGate re-renders children → Expo Router restores its saved route (/impostazioni) and the user is stuck. Fix: change to `router.replace('/(tabs)/cerca')` or `router.replace('/')`.
